items.name: noyzi-avatar
items.title: Noyzi Avatar
items.description: Avatar that shows a seed-based gradient while the photo loads, or when there is none.
items.docs: Use the user's id or email as the seed: <NoyziAvatar seed={user.email} src={user.image} alt={user.name} />

items.name: noyzi-image
items.title: Noyzi Image
items.description: Image with a seed-based gradient placeholder that stays if the image fails to load.
items.docs: The seed defaults to src. Size the wrapper with className: <NoyziImage src={post.cover} className="aspect-video rounded-lg" />
